page.restLater: The rest of your profile can be filled in anytime after.
page.invitedByHint: Create your profile to see who they think you should meet.
page.forSomeoneElse: Setting up a profile for your son, daughter or sibling?
page.previewBody: This is how other members will see you. Add a photo and a few details to appear in far more searches.
page.createBiodata: Create your biodata: share it on WhatsApp
page.quitBody: Your draft is saved. You can continue anytime you're ready.
page.verificationExpired: Your verification expired. Please verify your email or mobile number again.
page.createAccountFailed: Could not create your account. Please try again.
page.guardianSaveFailed: Your account was created, but we could not save all the profile details. Tap Retry: nothing you entered is lost.

basic.verifyMobile: Verify your mobile number to continue
basic.realNameHint: Your real name, as families will see it. Real names build trust.
basic.identityLocked: Gender and date of birth cannot be changed after sign-up. If one is wrong, <anchor>contact support</anchor>.
basic.dobHint: Used for age and horoscope matching. Your exact birthday is never shown publicly.
basic.heightNote: Optional, but profiles with height filled appear in more filtered searches.

location.countryRequired: Please tell us which country you live in
location.nriCheckbox: I'm an NRI / currently living outside India
location.nriHint: Helps us match you with families open to an NRI alliance and show prices in your currency.
location.familyBase: Where is your family based in India?
location.infoBody: We'll show you matches from your city and nearby areas.

religion.excludeGotra: Do not show me members with my gotra
religion.excludeGotraHint: They will not see you either. It applies to every search, daily matches and suggestions. Members who have not entered a gotra are still shown.
religion.infoBody: Your religious and cultural background helps us find compatible matches who share your values. Caste is optional.

horoscope.skipBody: Kundli isn't everyone's tradition. Skipping won't affect your profile or matches.
horoscope.timeOfBirthHint: As close as you know, used for Kundli matching.
horoscope.infoBody: These power Ashtakoot / Manglik matching. Fill what you know; add the rest later.

marital.label: Marital Status
marital.infoBody: TricityMatch is for everyone. Your marital status helps us find the right matches for you.

education.infoBody: Your education and career help us find someone with similar professional background and goals.

family.infoBody: Your family values help us find someone with similar family expectations and beliefs.

lifestyle.infoBody: These details help us find someone with a compatible lifestyle and habits.

about.label: About Yourself
about.placeholder: Tell us about yourself, your values, and what makes you unique... (max 500 characters)
about.noContactHint: Please leave out phone numbers, emails, links and social handles. Members reach you through TricityMatch, and your number goes only in Settings.
about.infoBody: A great bio and interests help matches get to know you and find common ground.

social.intro: Add your social profiles to look more real and approachable. Optional, you choose who sees each one. These are shown as links only, we never post or read anything.
social.footer: Links are shown only to members you have matched with. Set a link to Hidden to keep it just for you. Add profile links only, never a phone number.

preferences.ageRangeError: Minimum age cannot be greater than maximum age
preferences.mustAge: Must-have: only show me people in this age range
preferences.citiesHint: Tap all the cities you're open to.
preferences.mustCity: Must-have: only show me people in these cities
preferences.infoBody: Preferences guide who we suggest first. Anything you mark as a must-have is a rule: people who do not meet it will not appear in your search (you can switch this off from the search page).

photos.notImage: Please choose an image file (PNG or JPG)
photos.tooBig: File size must be less than 5MB
photos.label: Profile Photo
photos.dropHere: Drag a photo here, or click to browse
photos.moreLaterBody: You can add more photos to your gallery after completing the profile. Multiple photos increase your chances of finding a great match.

verify.needMobile: Please add and verify a mobile number to continue
verify.needEmail: Please verify your email to continue
verify.sendFailed: Failed to send code. Try again.
verify.trustBody: A confirmed number keeps out fake accounts and is the one members call once they unlock your contact. The verified badge comes later, from a live selfie.
